name: nyc
description: An open-source browser GIS for New York City — housing prices from recorded deeds, subway and bike networks, parks, flood zones, traffic injuries and boundaries, as toggleable MapLibre layers with choropleths, legends and a feature inspector. Also an MCP server (stdio + streamable HTTP) whose tools reach every dataset on NYC and NY State Open Data, and an in-app ASK NYC chat agent that answers from those tools with cited sources. Every source is public, key-free open data.
